name: Amulet of the Planes

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Shift Planes
powers.text: Magic action: name a plane and make a DC 15 Intelligence (Arcana) check; a success casts Plane Shift, a failure sends you and everyone within 15 ft somewhere random.

summary: Cast Plane Shift with a DC 15 Arcana check; a failure scatters you and those near you somewhere random.
text: Take a Magic action, name a place you know on another plane of existence, and attempt an Intelligence (Arcana) check against DC 15. Succeed and you cast Plane Shift. Fail and you, plus everyone and everything within 15 feet of you, are flung somewhere random: either a random spot on the named plane or a random plane altogether. (Inside the Mists of Barovia, no one can leave.)
